# Airborne — *Fallout: Equestria: The Airborne Chronicles*

Airborne is CivilWarPony’s wasteland-roaming pegasus hero: a former Grand Pegasus Enclave soldier turned *Dashite* (an Enclave outcast, not a secret identity), and—in this fan-fiction continuity—a descendant of Lightning Dust and Thunderlane. Fluttershy recruits him to find the missing Rainbow Dash and help avert a new pegasus civil war.

[![Cover art for The Airborne Chronicles](https://cdn-img.fimfiction.net/story/jpwv-1432467175-79572-medium)](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/79572/fallout-equestria-finding-rainbow-dash)

*Cover art: Turtledude, credited by author CivilWarPony on the linked story page. This is series title art, not a full-body portrait.*

**Recognize him:** Gray coat (light gray in the original prose, charcoal gray in the [fan-wiki profile](https://falloutequestria.fandom.com/wiki/Airborne_(The_Airborne_Chronicles))), blue eyes, brown mane and tail with black streaks, a weathered tan cowboy hat, a battle-saddle or Enclave armor, and a white parachute/yellow-star cutie mark.

**Name and continuity:** “Airborne” is the character’s name in CivilWarPony’s stories, not a Hasbro TV or film name. *The Airborne Chronicles* denotes the side-story series; *Dashite* identifies his faction/status. No verified earlier name or alter ego. He speaks extensively in the written dialogue, but has **no verified television appearance or screen voice actor**. His main adventures are *Finding Rainbow Dash* (2013), [*M.I.A.*](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/96738/fallout-equestria-mia) (searching for the original Wonderbolts), and [*Memories Best Left Buried*](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/205536/fallout-equestria-memories-best-left-buried).

## Important moments

These are prose chapters, **not television episodes**; season/episode numbers and verified video timestamps are unavailable.

1. **Accepts Fluttershy’s search** — *Finding Rainbow Dash*, ch. 1, [“Preparing To Leave”](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/79572/1/fallout-equestria-finding-rainbow-dash/part-one-preparing-to-leave): Agrees to investigate Rainbow Dash’s fate as war threatens the Dashites.
2. **Helps close the Crystal Empire’s tragedy** — ch. 5, [“Reunion”](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/79572/5/fallout-equestria-finding-rainbow-dash/part-five-reunion): Brings Shining Armor back to Cadance, allowing the long-separated couple to find peace.
3. **Awakens Rainbow Dash** — ch. 6, [“A Race To The Finish”](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/79572/6/fallout-equestria-finding-rainbow-dash/part-six-a-race-to-the-finish): Finds her preserved in a hidden chamber and helps bring her into the changed world.
4. **Risks his life to save New Cloudsdale** — ch. 7, [“War Comes Again”](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/79572/7/fallout-equestria-finding-rainbow-dash/part-seven-war-comes-again): Pilots the bomb-bearing *Titan’s Hammer* away from the city, then unexpectedly survives.
